answer: One workable design: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because harbor only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, horizon is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any juniper approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
